properties.name: m3.audit.migration-hint
properties.description: Included verbatim in {@link com.m3verificaciones.appweb.audit.schema.AuditSchemaVerifier} failure messages, so a stale/missing migration names the fix, not just the symptom (AD-1).
properties.defaultValue: Apply the owning migration in iot-platform-user-backend/database/migrations before deploying this service (002-create-audit-core.sql for audit_logs/revinfo, or the *-create-*-aud-tables.sql migration owned by this service).

properties.name: m3.audit.service-name
properties.description: Required. Identifies this service in {@code revinfo.service_name} / {@code audit_logs.service_name}.
